name: Needs
overview: Scripture reveals that God faithfully provides for the needs of His people, as seen in Psalms where the LORD is described as a shepherd who ensures we lack nothing. Those who fear and delight in the LORD experience His provision and are not forsaken or left begging, demonstrating His care for the righteous. Even in times of poverty and need, God remembers and helps His people, assuring them that He will not allow their souls to famish but will sustain them according to His righteousness.
